implementation_status: Express backend with persistent CSV import (SQLite default; MySQL adapter available)

empty_semantics.measured_zero: 0 only if input explicitly supports zero
empty_semantics.coverage: store observed_count and eligible_count alongside totals
empty_semantics.all_time: all eligible dated records supplied; account lifetime counters remain separate

metric_definitions.known_interactions: Sum available likes OR reactions, reported comments, shares/reposts and saves on deduplicated content. Do not add likes and reactions twice. Quotes/bookmarks remain separate until a validated formula includes them.
metric_definitions.combined_totals: Sum known platform values. Missing platform input stays null; show coverage. Followers and commenter totals are not deduplicated people across platforms.
metric_definitions.views_or_plays: Display mixed view/play total only with platform coverage and source provenance. Never add two counters describing the same content exposure.
metric_definitions.collected_comments: Count distinct successfully parsed comment IDs; independent of reported comment counters.
metric_definitions.returning_commenters: Distinct platform-scoped author IDs with comments on at least two distinct content items; exclude campaign author where identified.
metric_definitions.sentiment: Versioned exact / variation phrase rules; pending, positive, negative, neutral, mixed, unclassified. Manual review retained. No trained NLP model.
metric_definitions.trend_power: Needs validated recurrence rules, eligible windows and minimum coverage. No fabricated score from a single snapshot.
metric_definitions.risk: Reviewable repeated-text and dated comment concentration evidence; no authenticity percentage or proven-fraud conclusion.

proposed_routes.GET /api/analytics/:module: shared filters; values, records, coverage and provenance
proposed_routes.POST /api/imports/preview: multipart CSV -> mapping and validation; no replacement
proposed_routes.POST /api/imports/:id/commit: explicit confirmed scoped replacement in one transaction
proposed_routes.GET /api/collection-jobs/:id: stage, snapshot progress and failures; browser polls while active

security: API tokens server-only; authorize writes; no automatic scheduled collection.
import_mode: URL detection; type inference; date-independent preview/commit; idempotent shared upsert

access_and_library_routes.POST /api/login, /api/logout: Open or end a server session
access_and_library_routes.GET /api/data?keywords=1: Per-record matches and classifications for the selected filters
access_and_library_routes.POST /api/reviews: Administrator or analyst decision against current comment evidence
